name: Hashnode GraphQL API
description: The Hashnode Public API is a GraphQL API that allows developers to query publication data, manage posts and drafts, interact with newsletters, and create content via mutations. All requests go through a single GraphQL endpoint at https://gql.hashnode.com. Public read queries require no authentication; all mutations require a Personal Access Token in the Authorization header.

availableChannel.description: Single GraphQL endpoint for all Hashnode API queries and mutations
